summary: Back of Riverstage venue on a steep riverbank; loading yard, gated, busy.
reasons: Venue loading yard, staff and event trucks

drivers.seclusion: Tucked behind the Riverstage and mangroves, but the yard is an active venue and crew area.
drivers.access_and_room: Pin is in thick bush on the bank. The service road and yard are venue-controlled, with gates 99 m away and no room to stop clear of work vehicles.
drivers.traffic: Event and delivery traffic, with crew and equipment around the stage.
drivers.convention: Work vans and trailers belong to the venue; no campervans or tents seen.

flags: Brisbane Riverstage 3 m from the pin
Steep bank: DEM shows over 12% and a drop to about 0 m
Low-lying: about 4 m, river 170 m away
sun_shade: Pin sits in dense tree shade, with the stage building to the north.
